frequency_question: What proportion of major federal agency regulatory actions complete the notice-and-comment rulemaking cycle from proposed rule to final rule within 327 days?
membership_rule: Includes all federal agency rules designated as economically significant (costing over $100 million) that underwent standard notice-and-comment rulemaking; excludes interim final rules, emergency rules, and rules halted by statutory injunctions.

cases.name: EPA Mercury and Air Toxics Reconsideration

coverage_note: 10 named major economically significant rulemakings spanning multiple administrations; believed representative of complex procedural timelines.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture informal pre-rule delays or internal agency prioritization shifts before formal publication.
skeleton: Standard APA notice-and-comment minimum statutory periods (30-60 day comment window) plus OIRA review phases (up to 90+90 days) and agency drafting time.
multiplier: 10 cases analyzed, 6 completed within the strict 327-day equivalent calendar window, 4 exceeded it due to extended interagency review and complex comment integration.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act statutory timeframes and OIRA review structures remain stable across presidential administrations.
